description: §22.12 (S459 round 4 F1) positive — a `<label>` without `for`, and `<output for>`, render from runtime `meta.emit`.
rationale: §22.12 *Attributes*: `<output for>` only lists its inputs and is admitted; a label without `for` carries no reference. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
